description_ru: Пациент жалуется врачу на усталость и головные боли, и врач даёт советы по образу жизни.
text:
Dr Hughes: Good morning, Mr Novak. What brings you here today?

Peter: Good morning, doctor. For the past month I've been feeling exhausted, and I get terrible headaches almost every afternoon.

Dr Hughes: I see. Have you noticed anything that makes the headaches worse?

Peter: Possibly screens. I work at a computer for nearly ten hours a day, and I rarely take a break.

Dr Hughes: How have you been sleeping?

Peter: Badly, I'm afraid. I fall asleep quickly, but I wake up at three or four in the morning and can't get back to sleep.

Dr Hughes: And what about your diet? Do you drink much coffee?

Peter: Five or six cups a day, to be honest. My colleagues say that I live on caffeine.

Dr Hughes: That may be part of the problem. Let me check your blood pressure. Please roll up your sleeve.

Peter: Is it high?

Dr Hughes: It's slightly above normal, but nothing to worry about yet. I would say that stress is the main cause. I'm going to send you for a blood test, just to rule out anything more serious.

Peter: Do I have to stop drinking coffee completely?

Dr Hughes: Not completely, but I strongly recommend cutting down to two cups, and none after lunch. You should also take a ten-minute walk every few hours and look away from the screen.

Peter: That sounds easy enough. Anything else?

Dr Hughes: Yes. Try to go to bed at the same time every night, and switch off your phone an hour before. A study published last year showed that people who followed this advice slept considerably better within two weeks.

Peter: I'll give it a try. Should I come back?

Dr Hughes: Make an appointment for three weeks from now. If the headaches continue, we'll look at other options. Meanwhile, drink plenty of water and try not to overdo it.

Peter: Thank you, doctor. I feel better already.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка просуньте между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «з».
Кончик языка не касается нёба и не вибрирует; оттяните язык назад и слегка округлите губы.
Лёгкий выдох без трения в горле; не произносите как русское «х».
Долгий гласный: губы не округляйте, язык в середине рта; не заменяйте на «ор» или «ер».

questions.question: How long has Peter felt exhausted?
How many cups of coffee does he drink a day?
What does the doctor send him for?
